item.title: Shelby County 2026 primary ballot set as Democrats outpace GOP in candidate recruitment
item.description: Barring any changes, the ballot has been set for the 2026 primary contests in May. Unsurprisingly, Democrats have outpaced their Republican counterparts in candidate recruitment.
